effectSummary.ko: 자원 60를 즉시 빌립니다. 실제 받은 양만큼 빚이 남아 이후 자연 자원 회복을 먼저 상환에 씁니다. 3m 안의 직접 공격 적중 또는 방어 성공은 빚 4를 갚습니다. 공격 시전당 한 번, 방어는 1초 간격입니다. 상환 전에는 다시 빌릴 수 없으며 저장 복원·재장착으로 빚이 사라지지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Borrow 60 resource immediately. Only the amount actually credited becomes debt; subsequent natural regeneration pays debt first. A direct hit within 3m or a successful block repays 4, once per attack cast or once per second for blocks. Cannot borrow again until paid; saving, restoring and unequipping retain debt.

visualConcept: a clenched plated gauntlet gripping a short red-gold chain that loops back into a glowing sealed iron debt token, borrowed battle power with an unmistakable binding chain and restrained fiery energy
prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for W15 (Warrior). Main subject: a clenched plated gauntlet gripping a short red-gold chain that loops back into a glowing sealed iron debt token, borrowed battle power with an unmistakable binding chain and restrained fiery energy. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.

reuseReason.ko: 기존 HUD 아이콘은 256px 평면 도형이므로 이번 회화풍 1024px 원본 규격에 맞지 않습니다.
reuseReason.en: Existing HUD icons are 256px flat symbols and do not meet the requested painterly 1024px master specification.

notes.ko: 새 전투 컨셉의 주체와 방향이 64px에서도 구별됩니다. 밝은·어두운 배경에서 투명 여백과 내부 빈 공간, 주요 실루엣을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: The new mechanic silhouette and direction remain distinct at 64px. Reviewed transparent margins, internal gaps and primary shapes on light and dark backgrounds.
